params.name: workspaceId

params.name: scoreDetail
params.description: Include score details in response

params.name: sortOrder
params.description: Tells the API how to sort the output

params.name: sortBy
params.description: Specfies the property to sort on

params.name: types
params.description: Scorecard type

params.name: channels
params.description: Comma separated list of channels

params.name: startDate
params.description: Filter scorecards that have a start date greater than this date

params.name: endDate
params.description: Filter scorecards that have an end date less than this date

params.name: markets
params.description: Comma separated list of markets

params.name: creators
params.description: Comma separated list of user ids that created the scorecards

params.name: statuses
params.description: Comma separated list of scorecared statuses

params.name: searchText
params.description: Search text

params.name: brands
params.description: Comma separated list of brands

items.docs: This endpoint gets a list of scorecards for a given workspace. It supports several filtering options through query params.

params.name: mediaId
params.description: ID that identifies the media

params.name: channel
params.description: Comma separated list of platforms for which to get the media score

params.name: source
params.description: Specifies the media source

params.name: version
params.description: Specifies the media version

params.name: consideration
params.description: Specifies criteria consideration (MANDATORY,OPTIONAL or both)

params.name: format
params.description: Specifies the resonse format

items.docs: Provides criteria scores for media if they are available.

params.name: perPage
params.description: Pagination parameter to set page size

params.name: offset
params.description: Pagination parameter to specify offset from zero.

items.docs: This endpoint provides a list of criteria across all workspaces in an organization along with the organization level criteria.

params.name: scorecardId
params.description: ID of the scorecard to fetch media metadata for.

params.name: startDate
params.description: Impression start for inflight media—disregarded for preflight. Defaults to 3 months back.

params.name: endDate
params.description: Impression end date—similarly disregarded for preflight. Defaults to current day.

params.name: perPage
params.description: Pagination parameter to set page size.

params.name: offSet
params.description: Pagination parameter to specify offset from 0.

items.docs: Fetches a list of metadata objects for media in a given scorecard. When a date range is provided, it applies only to inflight scorecards and retrieves media with impressions within that range. Dates are otherwise disregarded for preflight scorecards.
